description: Maturity of the enumerated test space. A represented value is named by at least one fixture; executable means a route to evidence exists; executed and verified require a current record in the evidence ledger. The states are strictly nested and a value can never be counted in a state it has not reached.

dimensions.note: represented means a manifest names the value. represented_natively excludes proxy representations. executable means a route to evidence exists. executed and verified require a current record in evidence/ledger.json.
